title: Makefile Reference
content: Complete reference for all Make commands in tyttoot platform

items.title: Server Commands
items.content: Commands for managing the development server

items.title: make serve
items.content: Start PHP dev server on port 8080 and open doc site in browser

items.title: make status
items.content: Show PHP server status (check if running)

items.title: make open-doc
items.content: Open doc site URL in browser

items.title: make validate
items.content: Validate all doc JSON files against schema

items.title: make new-doc category=.. slug=..
items.content: Scaffold a new doc JSON file. Example: make new-doc category=guides slug=my-guide

items.title: make task-list [status=..]
items.content: List tasks (all or filtered by status: TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE)

items.title: make task-done id=..
items.content: Mark task as done (move to DONE)

items.title: make test-watch
items.content: Watch mode - re-run tests on file changes

items.title: Deployment Commands
items.content: Commands for building and deploying projects

items.title: make push project=<name> version=.. [branch=.. msg=..]
items.content: Push release to git with tagging

items.title: make history-add action=.. msg=..
items.content: Append a history entry to logs/history.jsonl

items.title: make version tag=.. msg=..
items.content: Create git tag and update HISTORY
